info.title: Tempera Risk API
info.description: Tenant-scoped deterministic risk decisioning and governed non-decisional research. LLMs are not called in the online decision path.

post.summary: Execute one principal-bound, signed, bounded graph read
post.description: Issues and consumes a one-use Risk mandate, calls the separately authenticated Tempera Graph service, verifies the complete signed response, and records paired receipts. The result is non-decisional. This operation mutates replay and audit state and is therefore not declared read-only to MCP clients.

200.description: Verified non-decisional graph result with signed mandate and paired receipts

post.summary: Register an immutable model artifact after dual human approval
Ingest a signed non-decisional score from an authenticated scorer workload
post.description: Human identities are rejected. The score is verified against the configured Ed25519 issuer registry and cannot itself authorize an action.

201.description: Human approval bound to exact target

post.summary: Open a governed multi-domain investigation case

get.summary: Read all completed non-decisional investigation dossiers for a case

post.summary: Grant purpose-, case-, subject-, actor-, field-, provider-, and time-bounded access
Revoke a sensitive investigation-data access grant
Ingest an evidence-backed bitemporal person or company profile
Find non-decisional identity-resolution candidates under an active case grant
post.description: Returns evidence-linked candidates, explicit conflicts, limitations, and review requirements. It never declares an identity match or merges subjects.
